scope: Actual self-contained release file evaluated from file: origin; no module replacement or world stubs
checks: Inline JS and fonts are embedded
English is the default; topbar switches Dutch/English/Dutch without changing money, level or catches
Complete loadout selection, saved rods per slot and component menus around a visible rod select real assemblies
Each equipped rod has its own live strike control; focus tabs are absent
Dashboard initializes with storage unavailable on file: in jsdom
One duration slider updates labels, licence cost and supplies without replacing the control, with daily steps from two to seven days
New games start with €150 and a cleanup click earns exactly ten cents
A complete session catches fish and ends
All eleven additional pages navigate without errors
Direct catch ledger defaults to sales without automatic payout; deselect all clears choices and blocks checkout without losing fish or paying money
Weight sorting works in both directions in the release without replacing the fishing scene or changing choices and money
Bulk release and mandatory processing preserve catch history
